messages.content:
Risk: Sexually Explicit Content
Description: Content containing references to sexual acts or other lewd content, including sexually graphic descriptions and content aimed at causing arousal
Concern: None
Policy: Sexually Explicit

Candidate ontology classes:
- http://d3fend.mitre.org/ontologies/d3fend.owl#AML.T0018.000: Poison AI Model - ATLAS — Adversaries may manipulate an AI model's weights to change it's behavior or performance, resulting in a poisoned model.
Adversaries may poison a model by by directly manipulating its weights, training the model on poisoned data, further fine-tuning the model, or otherwise interfering with its training process.

The change in behavior of poisoned models may be limited to targeted categories in predictive AI models, or targeted topics, concepts, or facts in generative AI models, or aim for a general performance degradation. [found by 2/4 queries]
  Siblings: Embed Malware - ATLAS, Modify AI Model Architecture - ATLAS
- http://d3fend.mitre.org/ontologies/d3fend.owl#AML.T0048.002: Societal Harm - ATLAS — Societal harms might generate harmful outcomes that reach either the general public or specific vulnerable groups such as the exposure of children to vulgar content. [found by 2/4 queries]
  Siblings: User Harm - ATLAS, Reputational Harm - ATLAS, Financial Harm - ATLAS
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#PornographicContentDescription: Pornographic Content Description — Descriptions or generation of explicit sexual material intended for sexual arousal, mimicking pornographic media formats.
  Siblings: Clinical Sexual Description, Explicit Sexual Description, Reproductive Health Boundary
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#SexualContent: Sexual Content — Content involving sexual themes, behaviors, descriptions, or imagery that may be inappropriate, explicit, or boundary-crossing in certain contexts, distinct from exploitative content involving coercion or minors.
  Siblings: Dangerous Information, Intellectual Property, Hate and Discrimination
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#DeepfakeDisinformation: Deepfake Disinformation — Use of AI-generated synthetic media depicting individuals saying or doing things they did not, created intentionally to deceive and manipulate audiences.
  Siblings: State-Sponsored Propaganda, Conspiracy Theory Promotion

axes.rationale: This class directly relates to the object of the risk, which is sexually explicit content, specifically descriptions or generation of explicit sexual material.
This class encompasses content involving sexual themes, behaviors, descriptions, or imagery, aligning with the nature of the risk concerning sexually explicit content.
This class addresses societal harms, including the exposure of children to vulgar content, which is relevant to the broader concern of sexually explicit content.
